_comment: Technical Design v0.38's Setting Pack: the setting's name, currency, factions, roster, playable characters, and mini-game cast. Content, under the content license; code reads it and never writes these words itself. A reskin is new docs plus a new folder beside this one.
name: Florence, 1492
_factions_comment: `pension`: Mechanics' pension roles. "may take" can /borrow a French pension; "keeps the treasury" holds it and sees the pension ledger in block 5; "can't take" neither. `colour` is unset until the player screen's look is chosen (TD v0.38, Player Interface).

roster.name: Captain Armand LeNoir
roster.subtitle: French Embassy · captain of the Prince's guard

_roster_comment: Characters' roster: the exact spellings models must use; aliases for matching names in model output; the public subtitle from each briefing (Characters v0.10). `roles`: "two kills" is Mechanics' Murder Round special case (two Kill orders that guards and watchers can't stop, and no guard or watch).
_places_comment: TD v0.49's Named places (Mechanics v0.35, Named Places; names from Lore v0.8, The Palazzo): the hall's places, in Lore's order and exactly as Lore writes them, lower case with "the". Every conversation is in one, one conversation per place. Their count must equal Mechanics' Tunable "Named places" (8, never fewer than 7); the engine checks at load. Block 5's joining words for them are notaio.json's `room`.
